summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $685K in annual savings across six spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners helped Advantia Health drive $684,936 in validated annual, recurring savings by renegotiating key contracts, enforcing purchasing policies and converting outsourced services to lower-cost solutions. Six categories moved through a full sourcing cycle, with three already finalized and the remaining three awaiting final paperwork or ramp-up. Signature wins include a 3.15% Athenahealth fee reduction, a regional medical-supplies rebid with McKesson, and a new in-house sonography staffing model.
